name: Park Systems Corp.
summary: Operating globally, Park Systems Corp. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced atomic force microscopy (AFM) systems. Its extensive portfolio encompasses AFM instruments designed for scientific research and surface analysis, along with in-line metrology, photomask repair, optical profilometry, and nano infrared spectroscopy services. The company also offers ellipsometry for comprehensive thin film characterization, active vibration isolation technologies, and a suite of proprietary software including Park SmartAnalysis, SmartScan, and SmartLitho. These sophisticated tools are utilized across a broad spectrum of sectors such as semiconductors, polymers, metals and ceramics, thin films, life sciences, 2D materials, surface engineering, anisotropic films, photonics, and display technologies, as well as in specific AFM applications. Established in 1997, the company, originally known as PSS Corp., officially rebranded to Park Systems Corp. in March 2007. Its headquarters are located in Suwon, South Korea.
